# Aura Sites

> Aura Sites is a web design studio based in Tokyo that builds custom,
> handcrafted websites for restaurants and small businesses, with a focus
> on bilingual (English/Japanese) sites that help owners reach foreign
> tourists and customers. Every site is set up to be easy for search
> engines and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) to find,
> understand and recommend. Japanese and English are separate static
> pages (Japanese at the root, English under /en/), not a client-side
> toggle, so either version can be read directly.

## Key pages

- Homepage: overview, process, portfolio, pricing (Launch, Grow, Studio tiers), FAQ.
  [Japanese](https://aurasites.studio/) / [English](https://aurasites.studio/en/)
- English websites for restaurants in Tokyo: who this service is for, what's included, and real prices.
  [Japanese](https://aurasites.studio/restaurant-websites-tokyo.html) / [English](https://aurasites.studio/en/restaurant-websites-tokyo.html)
- About: founder, languages spoken, why Aura Sites exists.
  [Japanese](https://aurasites.studio/about.html) / [English](https://aurasites.studio/en/about.html)
- Asiatis case study: a real bilingual website Aura Sites built, for a certified translation agency.
  [Japanese](https://aurasites.studio/case-study-asiatis.html) / [English](https://aurasites.studio/en/case-study-asiatis.html)
- Privacy policy.
  [Japanese](https://aurasites.studio/privacy.html) / [English](https://aurasites.studio/en/privacy.html)
